[[File:Ghost girl.png|thumb|250px|The ghost girl]]
The '''ghost girl''' is a [[Ghosts in the Pokémon world|specter]] and a [[character of the day]] that appeared in the {{aniseries|DP}} episode ''[[DP090|Ghoul Daze!]]''. She is an evil spirit that tries to capture [[human]]s and bring them to the [[Ghost World|spirit world]].

She first appeared in the bushes, waving her hands and asking [[Conway]] to play with her. She hypnotized Conway and tried to make him walk off a cliff, but {{p|Dusknoir}} saved him. The ghost girl also lured {{MTR}} with food, but Dusknoir appeared to stop her.

The girl later beckoned {{Ash}} and [[Angie]] to follow her to the [[Summit Ruins]]. Then, the girl tried to coax Ash and Angie into the mysterious cave, which was actually the entrance to the spirit world. Dusknoir prepared to attack the girl, but Ash and Angie battled Dusknoir to protect the girl. Dusknoir turned around to protect the two, blasted the girl into the spirit world, and collapsed the cave entrance, leaving her trapped.

==Trivia==
* The ghost girl appears in the book ''Pokémon Chapter Book #1: Diamond and Pearl: {{OBP|Pokémon Academy|book}}'', a novelization of the episode.
